name: Mephis
source:
"Hey, hey, come play with us."

Twin brother. Owner and designer of White Rabbits, a clothing store.

An innocent boy with adorable behavior who charms customers with his doll-like cuteness. Slightly more active than Ferres.

[Translated from https://x.com/aikawanemu/status/1677448860837511169]
